notes.title: Added CPU Difficulty Settings!
notes.content:
By popular demand, the ability to [b]adjust the difficulty of CPUs[/b] has been added to the game. The CPU difficulty setting can be found under 'Scuffle Settings'. (Four difficulty levels are available: Easy, Medium, Hard, and AFK.)
The old CPU difficulty is identical to the new 'Hard' difficulty. Now, all CPUs are 'Easy' by default.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]bug fixes[/b]
 - fixed a bug that made online client connection difficult without a controller
 - fixed a bug that caused server chats to be spammed with the host's name
 - fixed an oversight that prevented clients from adjusting their player colors
[*] improved character descriptions for clarity
[*] you can now easily view controls when more than 2 players are present
[/list]
